title: 3589. Count Prime-Gap Balanced Subarrays

examples.explanation: Prime-gap balanced subarrays are: [2,3]: contains two primes (2 and 3), max - min = 3 - 2 = 1 <= k. [1,2,3]: contains two primes (2 and 3), max - min = 3 - 2 = 1 <= k. Thus, the answer is 2.

Prime-gap balanced subarrays are: [2,3]: contains two primes (2 and 3), max - min = 3 - 2 = 1 <= k. [2,3,5]: contains three primes (2, 3, and 5), max - min = 5 - 2 = 3 <= k. [3,5]: contains two primes (3 and 5), max - min = 5 - 3 = 2 <= k. [5,7]: contains two primes (5 and 7), max - min = 7 - 5 = 2 <= k. Thus, the answer is 4.
